with YouTube Premium your videos / music will pause if you try streaming music at the same time as watching videos on one account - regardless of which subscription plan you are on (i.e., individual / family)

if you believe you're paying for both services but can in fact only use one at a time, to me that's testing the boundaries of honesty

reviews.text:
Shows graphic content even with no search history, no subscriptions, no interaction history, and restricted mode enabled. Very limited account management tab, (no option to delete all interactions at once) I have severe PTSD and I am disappointed with YouTube’s AI moderation, I shouldn’t have to wipe my entire YouTube account just to try and get other content. YouTube shorts needs to either be reworked or completely removed from the platform / made into it’s own separate application (like YouTube music, studio) and the AI models need to be trained on a more family friendly, safe, and appropriate algorithm. Furthermore, I feel as though my data is being used (voice, biometrics, app data from other apps) to push recommendations based on words that it overhears during idle conversations and T.V ambiance. I would like the option to disable Alphabet Inc.  from tracking that data, and their affiliates / subsidiaries. 

They should only have access to the data that they’re permitted within the YouTube / google applications and sites. 

I have a YouTube premium family plan, because I can’t stand the ads. I pay a little more than $30 dollars a month; I truly believe that given this fact, I deserve the right to my privacy. I’ve certainly been paying for it long enough.

Please be better, Susan.

reviews.title: New UI is awful
reviews.text:
YouTube completely changed both its UI and touch controls in an update recently. I hate the changes and would like to see them reverted. It seems like the changes were rushed and untested because of the amount of clunky interactions. 

When swiping to close a video you are required to then hit an x on the video to close it. After the video is finished with its shrinking animation and the x appears the location of the video is adjusted as a new menu raises onto the screen from the bottom. This never used to happen and leads to me attempting to close a video only to reopen the video. 

The menu mentioned above looks to minimalist and all of its character was removed in the redesign. I hate the new version. 

The touch controls were heavily reworked leading to the app doing things it has never done before in response to things I have been doing for years. 

As far as I can tell the calibration for what a tap is and what a swipe is are unoptimized leading to me accidentally opening videos constantly then struggling to close them because of the above mentioned changes. 

Long press functionality has been implemented needlessly and will open a menu repeatedly while I am scrolling. This wouldn’t bother me much if it wasn’t for the menu already having a dedicated button in the first place and interrupting the flow of the app. 

These changes were rushed and poorly tested and something needs to be done to make them not disrupt user experience.

Thought it was my internet at first but tested watching videos on my browser and it works just fine so definitely an app issue. 

On top of that, ads are utterly broken on the app and the platform as a whole, far too many, overly long and ad spots are often poorly implemented so that you have to sit through two unskippable ads then resume playback just for two more ads to start playing. I understand that obviously ads are needed on the free versions of YouTube but this is just ridiculous. 

Overall I would love to say I enjoy using the app but I quite literally cannot use it in a tolerable manner.
